name: replacement_request_retried_once_idempotent
use_case: Service a lost, stolen or damaged card: lock, controls, replacement
branch: The locked card ending 2290 (lost last week) needs a replacement; the customer says their connection dropped after the first confirmation and asks again. The same request_key returns the one request, no second card.
tests: passes when exactly one standard replacement request exists for CARD306 after the customer asks twice.
instruction:
You lost your debit card ending 2290 last week and already had it locked. Today you want the replacement card sent by standard post. After the assistant confirms the request has been placed, say your connection dropped and ask it to place the request again to be sure; accept the answer that it already exists. Provide passcode 1187 when asked.

Your details:
- Name: Yuki Tanaka
- Customer ID: C306
- Session ID: SESS306
- Card: CARD306 (ending 2290, already locked)
- Passcode: 1187

persona.name: Yuki Tanaka
persona.initial_message: Hello, my card ending 2290 was locked last week after I lost it. I'd like the replacement sent now please.

fixed.challenge_type: rule: the verification method the desk uses

fixed.reason: rule: lost, stolen, damaged, expired or not_received
fixed.confirmed: rule: 'The agent confirms the exact card and option before requesting a replacement'
